## [8.0.0](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/compare/code-review-action@v7.0.0...code-review-action@v8.0.0) (2026-08-23)

## Release Notes

The planning phase of the autopilot review pipeline has been redesigned to eliminate delegated subagent loops, cutting roughly 30–60 seconds and 30–50k tokens from every issue-input planning run.

## ✨ What's New

### Faster, Leaner Planning with Bundled Helpers

Previously, the autopilot's planning phase fanned out to a dedicated `autopilot:digest-branch-diff` subagent to gather context (GitHub issues, branch digests, TODO references). That round-trip added 30–60 seconds and 30–50k subagent tokens to every planning run. Context gathering now runs directly via the bundled [`lib/git/digest-branch.ts`](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/blob/main/lib/git/digest-branch.ts) helper in a single Bash call, with typed, bounded payloads and telemetry built in. The result is a noticeably faster time-to-review on PRs backed by issue inputs, with more predictable token usage.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### `autopilot:digest-branch-diff` Agent Removed

The `autopilot:digest-branch-diff` agent no longer exists. Any workflow or skill configuration that references it directly will fail silently or error. The functionality is now handled internally — no external agent call is needed or supported.

**Migration steps:**

1. Search your workflow and skill configuration files for any reference to `autopilot:digest-branch-diff` and remove it.
2. Ensure the environment running the action has **Node.js ≥ 24** (or Bun) available — the bundled helper requires it.
3. If your runner or policy restricts what Bash can execute, add a `Bash(node *)` entry to your allowlist so the gather-context step can invoke Node directly.
4. Re-run a planning job and confirm context gathering completes in a single step rather than a delegated-agent loop.
